validity.recommendation: none needed; note diameter varies (700 mm vs 500 mm at Sochi end per press) and Length/Capacity are single-source
validity.researcher_notes: Real, operating ~1974-75 onshore trunk (Maykop-Samurskaya-Sochi, Gazprom Transgaz Krasnodar). Not a duplicate of P0743 Dzhubga-Lazarevskoye-Sochi (separate 2011 line, 90% offshore; the two form the 'Black Sea gas ring' per Miller, kavkaz-uzel 2011). Start/Owner corroborated; Length/Capacity/Diameter single-source.

verifications.note: Gazprom Transgaz Krasnodar paper 2019-09-27: '45 years of operation' of the Maykop line (=~1974)

fills.researcher_notes: Start 1975 consistent with expert.ru ('построен в 1973-1975 годах') and the operator's own 2019 '45 лет эксплуатации' (~1974). Two independent sources agree within a year; sheet ref was the expert.ru home page, replaced by the deep-link Wayback capture (live deep link 404). A 2012 Kavkaz-uzel item cites a Sochi section laid 1978, so later sections exist.

verifications.note: Kavkaz-uzel 2011-06-06: Maykop-Samurskaya supplied Sochi at 1.5-2 bcm/y

fills.researcher_notes: 2.0 bcm/y is the upper end of the 1.5-2 bcm/y figure (kavkaz-uzel 2011-06-06, pre-DLS supply to Sochi, TASS-sourced). Single source, describes delivery to Sochi not nameplate; expert.ru 2008 adds that pressure had to be lowered for years (deliveries reduced). Searched operator pages and Russian press for a design figure; none found.

verifications.note: Vtg.com.ua (Wayback 2022) trunk table: Maykop-Samurskoye-Sochi, 700, 186 km, 1 string (hand-read; pipeline name spelled with hyphens)

fills.researcher_notes: 186 km per the Wayback table (name spelled 'Майкоп-Самурское-Сочи'). A 2012 Kavkaz-uzel item gives a rupture at km 180 of the line, consistent with ~186 km total. Single source: second source owed and not found (Gazprom Transgaz Krasnodar pages time out; searched Russian press).

700 mm per the vtg.com.ua trunk table (Wayback). Search-result snippets of Transgaz Krasnodar news (2020) describe replacement of 700 mm pipe on the line but those pages could not be fetched (krasnodar-tr.gazprom.ru times out, no Wayback capture), so not cited. Caveat: Kavkaz-uzel 2012-07-16 calls the line 500 mm at the Sochi rupture, so diameter may vary along the route.

fills.researcher_notes: Operator Gazprom Transgaz Krasnodar (Maykop LPUMG branch), a wholly owned Gazprom PJSC subsidiary, so Gazprom PJSC 100% follows; kavkaz-uzel 209794 states the line belongs to Transgaz Krasnodar. The parent step is not from a third-party ownership table.

verifications.note: names Maykop LPUMG, not the pipeline

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Sochistream 2025-09-16: Maykop LPUMG (Transgaz Krasnodar) works at the Sochi gas distribution station with reserve supply for districts; Maykop line is the main land supply to Sochi (Transgaz Krasnodar 2019 'основная артерия'). Page names the operator branch, not the pipeline, so tier low. No sign of retirement.

summary: "Maykop-Samurskaya-Sochi confirmed operating; Start/Owner corroborated, Length/Capacity/Diameter single-source; no unresolved"
